## Cross-Video SEO Strategy

### Hashtag Strategy (TikTok)
| Tier | Hashtags | Purpose |
|------|----------|---------|
| Tier 1 (High Volume) | #worldcup #soccer #football #fifa2026 | Core reach |
| Tier 2 (Trending) | #worldcup2026 #goals #reaction #viral | Trend riding |
| Tier 3 (Niche) | #stadium #fans #celebration #flags #bus | Targeted |

### Upload Schedule Recommendation
- **WC-01, WC-02, WC-03** — Upload first 3 days of week (highest engagement)
- **WC-04, WC-05** — Upload Fri-Sat (weekend traffic spike for sports)
- Space 2-3 days between uploads to avoid cannibalization

### Title Formulas That Work
1. **"The [Adjective] [Noun] [Emotion Verb]"** — e.g., "The Entire Bar Falls Silent 😨"
2. **"When [Event] [Action Verb]s [Emotion]"** — e.g., "When Your Team Scores at the World Cup 😭"
3. **"[Activity] Hits Different"** — Gen Z trend, works for relatability content

### Tags Priority (YouTube Shorts)
1. `worldcup2026` — highest intent
2. `fifa` / `fifaworldcup` — core brand
3. `soccer` — US search variant
4. `football` — international
5. `goal` / `goals` — content type
6. `celebration` / `reaction` — emotion signal
7. `viral` / `viralvideos` — aspiration tag
8. `stadium` / `sportsbar` / `home` — setting
